articleTitle: Dense Pedestrian Detection Method Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: For the current increasing number of pedestrian traffic accidents, driving vehicles can accurately and quickly detect pedestrians is one of the effective ways to avoid accidents. Aiming at the phenomena of omission and false detection of pedestrian detection in dense places by the current pedestrian detection model, a method is proposed to replace the CSP2_1 module with the BoT3 module based on the self-attention mechanism in the backbone network to improve the model's ability of extracting the global features; and to add the lightweight Hybrid Attention Mechanism HAM (Hybrid Attention Module) in the output side of the backbone network to enhance the model's ability of capturing important features, accelerate the convergence speed, and improve the model's convergence efficiency. Enhance the model's ability to capture important features to improve the model convergence efficiency, accelerate the convergence speed and improve the accuracy of the model. The experimental results on the homemade pedestrian detection dataset show that the average accuracy of the improved YOLOv5 model reaches 90.9%, which is 2.1% higher than that of YOLOv5. With little effect on the detection speed, the pedestrian missed detection is reduced and the detection accuracy is improved.

articleTitle: Using User Behavior Models and Visual Immersion to Optimize Digital Space Content
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: This research paper delves into the relationship between user behavior and visual characteristics in digital immersive spaces. Based on this, we experimented with a method of content optimization. The goal of this research is to enhance user experience by analyzing user behavior data to optimize visual content to meet user experience needs. In creating digital content, we pay close attention to the diversity and complexity of the user's visual and behavioral elements to ensure our methods fully utilize this information for content optimization. By analyzing user behavior data and making real-time adjustments to visual content, we aim to enhance the user's immersive experience in digital spaces. Through empirical research methods such as observation, experimentation, and data analysis, we discovered that an effective combination of user behavior elements and visual components, along with our content optimization, has a significant effect on satisfying user needs and enhancing the user experience in digital immersive spaces. This research provides designers and developers with a new and effective method to better meet the needs of users, enhancing user satisfaction and engagement in digital immersive spaces.

articleTitle: A Framework for Piano Online Education Based on Multi-Modal AI Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Piano online teaching under the epidemic is faced with the problems that students can't correct mistakes by practicing alone, the error prone points are hard to correct, and the playing status can't be continuously tracked and recorded. However, rapid development of multi-modal AI technology brings opportunities to the reform of the piano online education mode in the new era. This paper proposes a framework for piano online teaching based on multi-modal AI technology whose characteristics are below: first, multi-modal speech denoise and video processing is used for recording and correct online homework and learning processes of students; second, the individual learning model is constructed by means of knowledge graph to provide personalized guidance for students. Finally, through background data to track record, the periodic learning “portrait” of each student is depicted, providing comprehensive teaching evaluation. Therefore, teaching interaction is enhanced, and independent learning ability of students are cultivated. Through this way, online teaching effectiveness of music course is continuously improved, and the goal of improving the quality of online piano teaching is finally achieved.

articleTitle: HLC-KEPLM: Hierarchical Label Classification Based on Knowledge-Enhanced Pretrained Language Model for Chinese Telecom
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: The task of hierarchical label classification is currently an important task in the field of natural language processing (NLP), especially how to leverage the relationship between tags is a challenge. Most of the previous pretrained language models are based on contextual information modelling, ignoring the knowledge information, which is later injected into the language representation model. Inspired by the fact that knowledge can cover a diverse range of information and contribute to semantic understanding. We propose an improved model of hierarchical label classification based on knowledge-enhanced pretrained language model for domain of Chinese telecom (HLC-KEPLM), which learns with multiple local classifiers on top of pretrained language model with knowledge fusion in text classification. The core of our work is knowledge-aware encoder and multiple local classifiers fine-tuning. In the knowledge-aware encoder, we propose incorporating sememe knowledge through the HowNet knowledge base to fit the Chinese language features. In the fine-tuning stage, we exploit the relationship information between labels using the share encoder layer. We pretrained and fine-tuned on real data from the Chinese telecom domain and verified the effect resulting in an accuracy improvement of 6.4%.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Traffic Sign Detection Algorithm based on Improved YOLOv7
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: In order to achieve a lightweight network for traffic sign detection, we made improvements to the YOLOv7 object detection network, which include the following: 1. Replacing the original backbone with a lightweight PP-LCNet; 2. Using the CARAFE upsampling operator instead of the conventional upsampling methods; 3. Incorporating the SimAM attention module into the network; 4. Decoupling the detection head of YOLOv7. The training and testing were conducted on the CCTSDB dataset. The experimental results demonstrate that the improved YOLOv7 in this study has fewer parameters and lower computational complexity while achieving higher accuracy on the CCTSDB dataset. These findings indicate that the proposed modifications effectively enhance the performance of YOLOv7 for traffic sign detection while maintaining a lightweight network architecture.

articleTitle: Enhancing Industrial Anomaly Detection Using Edge Image Reconstruction with Neighbor Masked Convolutional Transformer Block
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Anomaly detection has become increasingly popular in recent years, where reconstruction-based approaches have been widely explored in. This approach usually assumes that the model can reconstruct normal patterns well but fails in anomalies, so that anomalies can be detected by evaluating the reconstruction error. However, it is usually difficult to control the model generalization boundaries in practice, because models with too much generalization ability will reconstruct the anomalous regions well, making them indistinguishable, and models with poor generalization ability fail to reconstruct the normal regions. In order to solve the above problems, we propose a new network that will reconstruct the original RGB image from edges of the image grayscale values by fusing the improved Neighbor Masked Convolutional Transformer Block, which achieves new and excellent results on the industrial anomaly detection MVTec-AD dataset.

articleTitle: Surface Defect Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv8 Model
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Surface defect detection is a crucial aspect of industrial quality inspection and remains a highly active research area. Although the YOLO series networks have gained widespread application in surface defect detection due to their superior detection speed, the current YOLO methods are typically built upon traditional residual modules, resulting in a significant computational burden. Moreover, the conventional feature pyramid network (FPN) employed in YOLO methods for feature fusion across various scales falls short in mitigating the accuracy degradation resulting from defect imbalance. To tackle these challenges, we propose a surface defect detection algorithm based on improved YOLOv8 model. Specifically, we propose a lightweight basic component to reduce the computational load of the network. Furthermore, we introduce a weighted average feature fusion approach that effectively combines features from different scales, thereby improving the detection accuracy of our method in scenarios with imbalanced defects. Moreover, to comprehensively evaluate the performance of the proposed method in practical applications, we created a surface defect detection dataset named Auto-DET by collecting 300 images from an automobile production line and annotating the defects with precise manual annotation. In our constructed Auto-DET dataset, our proposed method outperforms YOLOv8 by reducing the amount of parameters by 36.62% and FLOPs by 37.28%, while achieving a 3.5% improvement in mAP.

articleTitle: A Contour-Constraint Neural Network with Hierarchical Feature Learning for Lung Nodule Segmentation in 3D CT Images
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Current convolutional neural network (CNN) based lung nodule segmentation methods suffer from the loss of spatial information during the down-sampling procedure and the heterogeneity of lung nodules (texture, size, etc.), which leads to inaccurate segmentation results. To solve the problems, a contour-constraint neural network with hierarchical feature learning is proposed in this work. A contour detection module is introduced to extract rich edge information as prior knowledge and predict edge explicitly from the shallow layers, while a hierarchical feature module is suggested to utilize multi-scale features and produce object masks in the deep layers. A differentiable edge extractor is designed to extract the edge from the predicted mask to maintain edge consistency. A contour-constraint loss function is proposed to exploit the contour information produced by the contour detection module and constrain the predicted mask reversely. In this roundabout way, the learning of contour information is enhanced, allowing more accurate segmentation. Extensive experiments are conducted on the widely-used dataset LIDC-IDRI, and our method achieves competitive results compared to other state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: SRGCN: Social Relationship Graph Convolutional Network-Based Social Network User Geolocation Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: In location-based applications such as online shopping, recommendation system and disaster monitoring, the prediction of user geolocation plays an important role. Existing methods mainly utilize textual content and social network for location prediction, which fail to fully mine and fuse the two types of information on the one hand, and on the other hand, it is difficult to predict the location of isolated users in social network. Therefore, we propose a hybrid learning model Social Relationship Graph Convolutional Neural Network (SRGCN) to jointly model text features and network structure, in addition to constructing a social relationship graph for isolated users based on text topic similarity, and further improving the accuracy of location prediction through social relationships. The experiments on a real-world benchmark dataset validate the effectiveness of the method, showing that SRGCN outperforms existing methods in terms of average distance error, median distance error, and prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Lateral Ventricle MR Image Segmentation Based on Recursive Gated Convolution with Multi-Scale Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: The lateral ventricle, a crucial component of the brain structure, holds immense significance in medical image analysis and clinical diagnosis. Nevertheless, accurately segmenting lateral ventricles remains a challenging endeavor due to variations in their shapes and sizes, as well as image noise. In response to this challenge, we propose a novel deep learning network architecture that combines recursive gated convolution and multi-scale feature fusion strategies. Recursive gated convolution, as an effective convolution operation, adeptly captures long-range dependencies in images, thereby enhancing the network's capacity to discern lateral ventricular regions. Concurrently, we introduce multi-scale feature fusion to improve the network's characterization ability and segmentation accuracy by integrating feature information from different scales. Subsequently, we conducted an extensive experimental evaluation utilizing the publicly available IBSR dataset. The results of our experiments demonstrate the superiority of our method in MRI lateral ventricle segmentation. Our model achieved outstanding Pre, Dice, and Jac results of 92.93%, 92.84%, and 89.39%, respectively. Compared to other algorithms, our method accurately localizes and segments the lateral ventricle region, yielding finer segmentation outcomes.

articleTitle: Improving Yolov6 Mine Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of traditional convolutional networks detecting multiple targets missing underground and inaccurate detection of small obstacles, we propose an improved YOLOv6 algorithm aimed at improving the safety of mine employees. Firstly, we combine the multi head self attention mechanism with the maximum pooling layer to replace a portion of the convolutional layer in the model backbone framework, thereby improving the learning ability of the convolutional network for the global features of the target object. The network structure has been improved in the bottleneck layer, retaining the original detection accuracy while improving the target detection ability. In order to expand the receiving field range of the convolution layer, we use the funnel Activation function FRelu as the Activation function of the backbone network. In addition, we introduce depth separable convolution to improve the Rate of convergence of the model. After experimental verification, the improved detection algorithm has achieved significant results in mine detection. This algorithm determines the safety of employees in complex mine environments through portrait recognition in practical engineering applications.

articleTitle: Based on the Virtual Reality of Automatic Warehouse Training Simulation System Research
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: With the development of virtual reality technology and the increasing number of practitioners in automatic warehouse, virtual training has achieved great development. Due to the dense structure, compact equipment and narrow space of automatic warehouse, on-site training is difficult to observe and learn, and easy to bring loss of life and property due to illegal operation. In order to solve these problems and enable trainers to master related technologies faster, an automatic warehouse simulation training system based on virtual reality is created. This training system uses the handle and head-mounted virtual reality display as the human-computer interaction window to realize learning and roaming in the full virtual scene. It is verified by experiments that the SUS score of the system is 78, which is within the acceptable range, the System Usability performance reaches about 80%, and the usability rating is between Good and Excellent. In addition, the SSQ score is 14.4 points, which is at a relatively low level. In a word, this system simulates the real environment of automatic warehouse, improves the learning flexibility, security, and training efficiency of trainees through virtual training and has good usability.

articleTitle: Research on Preprocessing Method for Massive Operations and Maintenance Data Based on Fuzzy Correlation
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: The trend of diversified, multi-dimensional, and complex development of power operation and maintenance data has led to the traditional processing methods for massive operation and maintenance data being unable to meet the current needs and development requirements of the power system. This paper studies an intelligent processing system for massive power operation and maintenance data based on fuzzy correlation, and combines the application of data label system in data centers to deeply mine data features, Discovering the interconnection relationship between basic data labels and deep data labels, forming fuzzy data labels and fault prediction labels on this basis, facilitating the storage and analysis of a large amount of operation and maintenance data, reducing system load rate, and achieving data interconnection between different systems.

articleTitle: A BERT-GCN-Based Detection Method for FBS Telecom Fraud Chinese SMS Texts
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: In the past decade, Fake Base Stations (FBS) have been consistently employed by criminals to target mobile users through spam text messages. Despite the introduction of several techniques to mitigate this problem, spam messages remain a persistent and challenging issue in some countries, such as China, resulting in billions of dollars in annual economic losses. Therefore, this paper proposes an algorithm named BERT-GCN that combines large-scale pre-training models with Graph Convolutional Networks (GCN) for multi-class detection of fraudulent base station telecommunications scams in Chinese text messages. First, BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representation from Transformers) is used to encode the corpus and generate word embeddings. Subsequently, the generated word embeddings are fed into GCN for training. Finally, a Softmax layer is employed to perform multi-class detection on fraudulent base station telecommunications scams in Chinese text messages. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model achieves favorable performance on the FBS-SMS-Dataset and exhibits outstanding performance in the domain of multi-class detection.

Author Keywords: Detection of FBS Telecommunications Scams in Chinese SMS texts

articleTitle: Research on Unmanned Positioning Technology Based on Factor Graph Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: A fusion positioning algorithm based on factor graph optimization is proposed to tackle the issues of low positioning accuracy and poor environmental adaptability associated with a single sensor in the unmanned positioning system. This algorithm integrates data from multiple sources, including the Global Positioning System (GPS), Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU), Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR), and wheel tachometer. Through front-end processing and back-end optimization, the algorithm significantly enhances the accuracy and adaptability of the unmanned positioning system. Validated under a scenario of the missing differential signal and laser point cloud features, the fusion positioning algorithm, harnessing factor graph optimization, exhibits substantial accuracy improvements of 84% and 63% over laser-based Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) and GPS, respectively.

articleTitle: Short Text Similarity Detection Based on Graph Attention Networks and Knowledge Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Text similarity detection is a crucial task within the field of natural language processing Traditional word embedding methods consider about either semantics or structure of the text, and rarely consider knowledge-based information. Therefore, these methods have insufficient information for text representation and are ineffective in dealing with word polysemy and deep interactions among words. In this paper, firstly HowNet, as a knowledge base, is introduced in the graph attention networks to encode the sememes in HowNet. Secondly, we design the self-attention mechanism to strengthen the correlation among words obtained from the graph attention networks. Finally, the enhanced word vectors are fused with the word vectors generated by the pre-trained BERT model to obtain a more comprehensive text representation. The experiments conducted on three Chinese datasets demonstrate the superior performance of our model outperforms other conventional text similarity detection models.

articleTitle: Research on Path Optimization of Automated Warehouse Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low efficiency and utilization rate of goods in traditional warehouses. Firstly, the genetic algorithm (GA) is used to optimize the path of the key equipment in the automated warehouse, namely the stacker, and then the purpose of simulation verification is realized by using Matlab software. The final experimental results show that the GA model has obvious effect on the path optimization of the stacker, which can greatly improve the efficiency of goods in and out of the warehouse, save time cost and reduce the energy consumed by the key equipment in the process of goods picking.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of Ergonomic Simulation Platform for Complex System Equipment Based on Virtual and Real Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Objective To design an assembly system of complex equipment based on the integration of virtual and real engineering of human factors engineering by improving the comfort of assembly operators, improving assembly and operation and maintenance technology, reducing operation time, and improving the assembly and operation and maintenance efficiency of equipment. Methods This paper comprehensively considers the human factors in the assembly process, combines virtual and real fusion technology to construct a virtual assembly simulation system, and through in-depth study of motion capture, physiological acquisition, assembly sequence planning, ergonomic analysis and other technologies in the virtual assembly of complex equipment. Results Break through the traditional Tecnotamix ergonomic simulation software such as Dassault Delmia and Siemens' Tecnomatix ergonomic simulation software only through computer virtual simulation for ergonomic analysis of equipment and ignore the subjective consciousness of assembly personnel in the real physical world. The difficulty of the influence of experience, psychological characteristics, ability limits, etc. On the assembly process. Conclusion The simulation of virtual and real fusion assembly and operation and maintenance of complex system equipment based on human factors engineering is carried out, and the new generation of virtual and real simulation technology combined with physiological acquisition equipment is used to quickly build assembly scenarios and analyze the assembly and operation and maintenance process of equipment in real time, so as to provide an optimization scheme for the assembly process design of complex system equipment.

articleTitle: Chinese News Headline Classification Method Based on ERNIE
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: To solve the problems of semantic ambiguity and feature sparsity in news headline classification tasks, a news headline classification method based on ERNIE is proposed. Firstly, the input text is embedded by the pre-trained language model Enhanced Representation through Knowledge Integration (ERNIE) to obtain dynamic word vectors, solving the problem of polysemy. Then, we use TextCNN and set multiple sizes of convolutional kernels to extract different levels of semantic information from the text. Finally, softmax is used to normalize the output, and the category corresponding to the maximum probability value is taken as the classification result output. Experimental results show that this method can effectively solve the problems of sparse features and semantic ambiguity, and improve the classification performance of news texts.

articleTitle: Foreign Object Recognition Method of Coal Mine Conveyor Belt Based on Lightweight Network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Foreign objects in coal mine conveyor belts are a crucial factor causing conveyor belt damage. Using intelligent methods to accurately recognize foreign objects in coal mine conveyor belts is beneficial for the safer and more stable operation of the conveyor. In this paper, a novel coal mine conveyor belt foreign object recognition method based on lightweight ShuffleNetv2 network, named ASLNet, is constructed. Firstly, the 3x3 depthwise convolution in the ShuffleNetv2 network basic module is replaced by a 5x5 size, which increases the range of the sensing field and is easy to capture the global features of the foreign object target. Second, a lightweight ECANet (Efficient Channel Attention Network) attention mechanism module is added to the ShuffleNetv2 network module to strengthen the coal mine conveyor belt foreign object features and suppress the background features. Finally, the network structure is optimized by reducing the number of stacks in each module to improve the speed of foreign object recognition and reduce the number of model parameters. The experimental results show that the ASLNet model has a parameter number of 0.33x10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup>, a model size of 1.26M, and a recognition accuracy of 97.62%, which is 3.91 percentage points higher than that before the improvement. Compared with the classical ResNet34, ResNet50, DenseNet, GhostNet, and MobileNetv2 recognition networks, the optimized network not only has higher recognition accuracy, but also has fewer parameters, which lays a solid technical foundation for the online real-time recognition of foreign objects in coal mine conveyor belts.

articleTitle: Attention Module Based on Feature Normalization
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Attention mechanism is an essential component in convolutional neural networks. Although attention modules like SE and CBAM have achieved tremendous success in fields such as image classification and object detection, most existing attention modules can only perform feature fusion in either channel or spatial dimensions. This greatly limits the flexibility of attention mechanisms to adapt in both channel and spatial dimensions, leading to underutilization of feature information. To address these issues, we propose a Feature Normalization-based Attention Module (FNAM) in this paper. This module generates a feature normalization weight map from the input feature map. During the normalization process, the scale and shift parameters for each channel are derived from the mean and standard deviation of the feature map. Consequently, this approach effectively utilizes feature information from all dimensions. To demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of this attention module, we conducted ablation experiments. In the image classification task, the FNAM module shows a significant improvement in the performance of classification networks on the CIFAR dataset compared to other mainstream attention modules. In the object detection task on the VOC dataset, the FNAM module outperforms most other attention modules. Particularly, concerning small and medium-sized objects in the dataset, its detection accuracy reaches the highest, with improvements of 1.6% and 1.5% respectively.

articleTitle: Joint Relation Extraction Model Based on Potential Relation and Entity Boundary Information
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Extracting entities and relation from unstructured text is a crucial step in building knowledge graphs. Existing methods have achieved certain effectiveness, but issues such as entity nesting and relation redundancy still persist. Regarding the mentioned problems, a method of Potential Relation and Entity Boundary Information (PREBI) is proposed. At the start, the model uses a pre-trained model for representing the encoded input text, then predicts the relation present in the sentence through a potential relation extraction module, incorporating entity boundary information to jointly model and generate relation triplets. Experiments conducted on the DuIE2.0 dataset demonstrate outstanding performance on Chinese data, with an F1 score of 76.41%.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Image Monitoring System Based on Cortex A53
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: At present, with the rapid development of economy and technology, the quality of the people's life has been generally improved, and the importance of the security system has become increasingly prominent. Among them, the image monitoring system has attracted more and more attention because of its intuitive and rich information content, making it an important part of the security system. Based on this, an image monitoring system is designed. The system uses the GEC6818 platform and is equipped with the Samsung Cortex-A53 series high-performance eight-core processor S5P6818. The system uses ubuntu, selects the camera to collect the surrounding environment image in real time, studies the data structure and principle of the image acquisition software, introduces the process and key steps of image acquisition, and completes the design of the image acquisition program using API functions, The collected image is displayed on the touch screen after being filtered and enhanced. After debugging, the system has reached the expected goal. The system can play a good reference role in the security of homes, communities and other places.

articleTitle: Construction and Research of Multi-Target Tracking Method in Low Light Scene Based on PP-YOLOE+m and PP-Tracking
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Multi-target tracking in low-light scenes is an important research direction under of computer vision. Effective multi-target tracking methods in low-light have scenes are of great significance for applications such as video surveillance, unmanned driving, and intelligent security. Under this environment, due to insufficient light and noise interference, it faces problems such as unstable low-light image enhancement effect, target association accuracy and robustness, algorithm real-time performance and computational efficiency. Under this paper, the PP-YOLOE+m model is used for multi-target tracking in low-light scenes. By training and optimizing the PP-YOLOE+m model, the target detection ability of the PP-YOLOE+m model in low-light scenes is improved. At the same time, combined with the PP-Tracking algorithm, the accurate tracking and ID maintenance of the target can be realized. Using the ExDark dataset to evaluate the effect of the multi-target tracking method in this paper, the accuracy of multi-target tracking has been improved by 3.6%, which verifies the effectiveness and robustness of the method in this paper. Experimental results show that, the method proposed can more accurately track multiple targets, and provides guidance for vision applications in low-light scenes in low-light environments.

articleTitle: User Profile Construction Based on Multi-Channel Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of existing user profile construction algorithms that do not fully utilize contextual structural information and multidimensional feature information., a user profile construction model based on the pre-training model NEZHA, Deep Pyramidal Convolutional Neural Networks (DPCNN), Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), and attention mechanism is proposed, NCDGA. The method uses multiple channels to process the text, capturing different dimensions of information and constructing features to reduce the prediction bias that occurs when a single model captures a single feature. The experimental results show that the NCDGA model has better accuracy and effectiveness compared with other modeling methods.

Author Keywords: Neural Contextualized Representation for Chinese Language Understanding (NEZHA)

articleTitle: Finger Vein Recognition Based on Multi-Orientation Binary Patterns and Collaborative Representation
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: In view of the fact that finger veins are sensitive to noise and deformation during image collection, a method of identifying finger veins based on a multi-orientation binary pattern (MOBP) combined with collaborative representation (CR) is proposed. Firstly, the orientation feature of the finger vein is represented by the encoding of principal orientation and orientation confidence. Secondly, the dominant orientation and secondary dominant orientation are combined to form the most recognizable orientation coding, to improve the effectiveness of orientation coding. All the features are fused in the form of a histogram. Finally, the method of cooperative representation is used to classify them. Experiments results indicate that the average recognition rate for SDUMLA-HMT, FV-USM, and THU-FVFDT2 finger vein database is 99.43%, 99.69%, and 99.75%, respectively. The experimental results have obvious advantages compared with other traditional and popular algorithms.

articleTitle: A Study of Music Genres Based on Social Networks and Statistical Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: The study of musical influence is important for understanding the creative laws of musical works and musicians, as well as for examining the social culture of a particular era, whereas the sociological study of music is more intuitive and not accurate enough because it does not apply many mathematical methods. The aim of this paper is to develop a series of mathematical methods to measure the social impact of music and enrich the research tools of musicology. In this paper, an influence network and a similarity network are created on nodes representing artists. In the influence network, the PageRank algorithm is used to measure the influence of the artist. In the similarity network, weighted Euclidean distance is used to measure the similarity between any pair of music, where entropy weighting method is used to establish the weights in the Euclidean distance. Finally, community detection is performed in the similarity network using Louvain's algorithm, and a fit metric is invented to examine whether genres are reflected in the community. The above mathematical methods give results that find their counterparts within the sociology of music, proving that the methods developed in this paper are valuable.

articleTitle: 5E Teaching Model Based on Neural Network Data Sampling and Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Clustering analysis plays a decisive role in data processing in information exchange system. Select internal connection to make database data. Internal connections for in-group database data should be as large as possible, and internal connections for non-in-group database data should be as small as possible. Through the way of teaching-testing-analysis and summary, students' scores are taken as the only reference index. This mode only gets the results on the final scores, which can not predict and arrange the knowledge mastery of different types of students, and also causes the uncertainty of professional courses. Through the introduction of 5E teaching model, taking into account the basic indicators such as reading rate, it is easy to capture students' interest habits. In this paper, based on the basic indicators of professional courses, data sampling is carried out from the information of students' interest in courses. The indicators of self-mastery ability and learning time are the comprehensive performance of students' thinking ability and the attractiveness of professional courses. Then the least square method of clustering analysis is adopted to divide the students into different types according to their interest. Finally, the clustering subdivision of data sampling is achieved. 224 pattern works were selected for experimental analysis. After the experimental test, comparative analysis of the algorithm effect, this algorithm can measure the results of the students' pattern works algorithm recognition, and judge the degree of coincidence of the test situation. Compared with random forest algorithm, genetic algorithm and traditional mode, it is obvious that the test accuracy of this algorithm is more than 97%, while the test accuracy of traditional mode is the lowest-less than 95%.

articleTitle: A Self-Verification Evaluation Method of Accuracy for RGBD 3D Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: 3D reconstruction with RGBD images is a popular research issues in 3D vision as the easily accessibility of depth camera which can out depth images directly. The accuracy evaluation of a 3D reconstruction algorithm is indispensable no matter for academic research or for industrial application. Most evaluation methods used now, such as Absolutely Trajectory Error or 3D surface error, rely on the ground truth values provided beforehand as reference. These methods can only be used on datasets providing these reference values which are difficult to obtain. Actually for the practical reconstruction of a physical object or scene, there is no ground truth to refer and it is hard to assess the quality of the reconstructed results. A self-verification evaluation method of accuracy for RGBD 3D reconstruction without need any ground truth is proposed in this work to address this issue. During the reconstruction process, we generate depth images based on the estimated camera poses and 3D model. With the input depth images as reference, an accuracy metric is elaborated by computing the differences between the generated depth values and the inputted depth values. Experimental results illustrate the effectiveness of our proposed method which can give evaluation results consistent with the ATE metric.

articleTitle: Single Image HDR Reconstruction via A Feature Modulation Network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Reconstructing HDR images from a single LDR image with noise and saturated regions is a highly challenging problem. Recent approaches have utilized cascaded network structures to address this challenge in image space. However, this approach increases the difficulty of network training and may lead to cumulative errors. To this end, we propose a feature modulation network (FMN) for image denoising and HDR generation in feature space. Our FMN introduces a simple yet effective Feature Modulation Block (FMB) that combines an Enhanced Attention Module (EAM) and a Dilated Residual Dense Block (DRDB). The EAM effectively eliminates image noise using multiple residual blocks, while the DRDB learns the details lost in saturated regions of the input image with a large receptive field. Moreover, we employ a Space Feature Transform (SFT) layer to perform spatial-wise feature modulation. Extensive experiments are conducted on publicly available datasets, and the results demonstrate that our method achieves competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Deformable Convolution Based Feature Extraction for Multi-View Stereo
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Deep learning based multi-view stereo algorithms have shown great reconstruction performance. We propose a method called DCMVSNet for depth inference from multi-view images. We choose to build a cost volume pyramid in a coarse-to- fine manner that leads to a lightweight network. It has an efficient feature extraction module based on deformable convolutional network. The proposed multi-stage network architecture can fully utilize multi-scale feature maps to achieve better reconstruction results. Experiments on popular datasets demonstrate that the proposed method achieves the exceptional reconstruction performance.

articleTitle: YONA: An Intelligence Question-Answering System Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is designing an intelligent question-answering system. In the context of education informatization, university students tend to lack guidance in their studies. This paper proposes an intelligent Q&A system for university teaching that integrates intelligent dialogue and machine learning technologies. The proposed system includes intelligent Q&A module, the tutor recommend & match module, tutor Q&A system module, Q&A forum Module and user compasrison report module. The system utilizes BERT model, collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm, multi-threaded programming, TF-IDF algorithm and K-Means algorithm to implement the modules in the system. The proposed system deployed with Aliyun cloud server, CDN, load balancing, client testing, and online optimization. The pilot of this system demonstrated excellent performance: an average of 4 queries per person, with an average query duration of 7 minutes. The success rate of problem resolution reached 85%, and the average response time was 30 seconds. This system will promote the health of the education industry and enable intelligent learning diagnosis. The authors hope to contribute to improving the quality of life of college students and society by designing an intelligent question and answer system.

articleTitle: Binary-SE-ResNet Model Research for Binary Classification of Chest X-Ray
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: In 2019, the outbreak of the novel coronavirus swept across the globe. With the increase in the number of infections, the demand for automated pneumonia detection gradually increased. This study mainly focused on the binary classification problem of pneumonia images and proposed a Binary-SE-ResNet that utilizes both the original image features and LBP image features extracted through the SE-ResNet34 model. The extracted features are then concatenated and input into an XGBoost model, which is optimized by a Bayesian optimizer to select the best model for the final classification. Considering the characteristics of the dataset, this study employed CLAHE for image enhancement during the preprocessing stage to improve contrast and noise reduction. Ultimately, the proposed model achieved an accuracy of 97.7% in the binary classification of pneumonia, which is a 0.9% improvement compared to the best single model. This demonstrates that the approach of extracting features from different feature maps and utilizing ensemble learning can better capture features and achieve improved classification performance.

articleTitle: A Study of Chinese Semantic Analysis Based on Enhanced Lexicon
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Sentiment analysis using natural language processing and machine learning techniques can determine the sentiment or emotional tone expressed in large amounts of text. However, due to the presence of Chinese polysemous words, current sentiment analysis lacks effective analysis for various specific domains. As a result, sentiment analysis in Chinese faces challenges. To address this issue, this paper presents a novel domain-specific sentiment analysis system. The system combines the advantages of two major sentiment analysis methods: lexicon-based sentiment analysis and machine learning analysis. First, the Naive Bayesian classification algorithm is used to extract words, accurately discriminate their emotional polarity, and form an enhanced lexicon suitable for a specific domain. Then, three commonly used machine learning classifiers are used to compare the effects of semantic analysis before and after using the enhanced lexicon. Experimental statistics show that the sentiment orientation accuracy of the Chinese financial commentary sentiment analysis system proposed in this paper can be improved by about 5%.

articleTitle: Research on Power Optimization of Massive Machine Type of Communication Based on 5G Big Connection
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: In this paper, a resource allocation algorithm based on capacity maximization for massive Machine Type of Communication (mMTC) is studied. Taking LTE single cell as the background, considering the coexistence of LTE cellular user devices and mMTC devices, a two-layer network model is established in mMTC scenario, and mMTC gateway is introduced to analyze the transmit power control strategy of mMTC gateway (mMTCG) in mMTC scenario. On this basis, the bandwidth and power resource allocation problem in mMTC scenario is studied by using deep reinforcement learning algorithm to maximize the system capacity. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can improve the capacity of the system, and the power control is more consistent with the characteristics of mMTC scenario.

articleTitle: Time Series-Based Electric Load Forecasting with Mixture of Expert System
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: In this paper, a novel approach for electric energy prediction utilizing a hybrid expert system integrated with a time series model is introduced. The proposed method leverages the concept of a hybrid expert system to construct multiple time series expert models, each equipped with its corresponding gating module, thereby enabling the selection of diverse expert models for enhanced electric energy prediction accuracy. The methodology comprises several key steps. First, the construction of a time series expert model involving the integration of three distinct time series methods. Second, the training of the time series expert model, encompassing hyperparameter optimization and parameter optimization procedures for each constructed model. Third, the model blending process is based on the hybrid expert system, wherein the gating module is jointly trained alongside the time series expert models, allowing for the dynamic mixing of expert models based on varying input characteristics. Finally, the electric energy prediction is executed using the mixed expert combination within the hybrid expert system. Experimental results on real-world datasets demonstrated the effectiveness compared to competitive baselines.

articleTitle: Design of Digital Baseband Communication Link for ISO18000-6C RFID Reader Based on Zynq-7000 All Programmable SoCs
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: This paper introduces a new digital baseband processor for UHF tags, which is a low-power digital circuit. Based on ISO/IEC18000-6C protocol, this design establishes the system architecture of the reader and focuses on the key technologies of the digital baseband in the physical layer of the reader as follows: the high-speed processing capability of the on-board ZYNQ is utilized to implement the transmit link design of the reader, encompassing the data encoding, group framing, clock management, random number generator and cyclic redundancy checksum. VIVADO is employed to simulate the communication between the tag and the reader, and the simulation results meet the design requirements.

articleTitle: Self-Similarity Attention Module for Skeleton-Based Fine-Grained Action Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Fine-grained action recognition poses a significant challenge as it involves distinguishing subtle and distinctive motion variations within fine-grained action categories. Previous methods have improved performance by enhancing the network's ability to capture variations in the action space and temporal changes. However, they face limitations in effectively distinguishing subtle differences within actions when they involve varying numbers of repetitions. In this paper, we propose an effective module called the Self-similarity Attention Module (SAM). This module represents the self-similarity of actions using the Temporal Self-similarity Matrix (TSM) and utilizes channel-wise excitation to capture the periodicity information in actions. The Self-similarity Attention Module can be embedded into any 3D convolutional neural network. Our approach outperforms previous skeleton-based action recognition methods on the wildly used FineGym dataset, which confirms its effectiveness and efficiency.

articleTitle: Two-Stage Multi-Instance Multi-Label Learning Model for Video Social Relationship Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Recognizing social relationships among characters from videos facilitates multimedia content analysis and helps viewers understand the storyline quickly. However, treating the information at each moment in the video equally will affect the extraction of information related to social relationships. Most existing methods only consider the social relationships between any two characters in the video, ignoring the potential correlations of social relationships among multiple characters. To address these issues, we propose a Two-Stage Multi-Instance Multi-Label learning model (TSMIML) for video social relationship recognition. In the first stage, we focus on obtaining effective social relationship features and mining which moments' information reflects the social relationships between characters better by generating multiple instances. In the second stage, we focus on discovering which social relationships exist in the video, exploring potential correlations among social relationships to promote social relationship recognition in the video. Compared with the state-of-the-arts methods, extensive validation on the large-scale dataset has demonstrated the effectiveness of our proposed model.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Data Label System Based on Data Indicator Health Rating Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: With the rapid development of smart grid, the power system operation and maintenance data tends to be multi-source, Discretization and multi-dimensional, and the power operation and maintenance and dispatching departments can not efficiently and accurately integrate and analyze the complex and diverse monitoring status of power equipment, resulting in the inability of all power grid departments to coordinate operations. This article combines the data indicator health row scoring algorithm to optimize the existing data label system structure. After normalizing the data provided by the operation and maintenance department, the probability of various events occurring during the operation and maintenance process is calculated based on probability principles. Combined with the weight of the data indicators in the labeling system, the corresponding score for the system object is finally given. According to the threshold rules of the indicators, the process of data screening, alerting, and other processes is completed, Assist the operations department in completing data analysis and integration work more efficiently.

articleTitle: Prediction of Dry Powder Cleaning for Airport Navigational Lights Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: This article uses ABAQUS software to establish a two-dimensional cleaning model based on the Yeoh theoretical model. It simulates and analyzes the dry powder cleaning process of rubber dirt on the mirror surface of airport navigational lights at different angles. The optimal washing angle is determined to be 35°. A gas-solid two-phase flow model is then simulated and analyzed using Fluent. Based on the simulation results., a BP neural network model is established to predict the washing effects under different factors such as inlet pressure., jet target distance., and abrasive flow rate. The aim is to improve the efficiency of automated cleaning and save energy consumption.

articleTitle: Opening the Black Box: Interpretable Machine Learning Reveals the Relationship Between Lexical Diversity and Writing Quality
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Machine learning serves as the core component of artificial intelligence (AI), however, there is scant interdisciplinary research between AI and applied linguistics. Very few studies touched upon the aspect of how to leverage interpretable machine learning to solve the problem in language learning, teaching, and assessment. This study aims to lift the veil and fill this gap by employing interpretable machine-learning approaches to explore the relationship between lexical diversity and writing quality. The findings contributed to providing a finer-grained understanding of the CET-4 writing construct and its rating scale. Furthermore, it may lend empirical evidence for the Dynamic Systematic Theory (DST) in language acquisition, verify the validity of automatic essay scoring, and advance teachers' language assessment literacy in the long run.

articleTitle: MAF-CDR: Multi-Omics Data Integration for Cancer-Drug Response Prediction Model
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Achieving precise application and rapid discovery of anticancer drugs has been an important topic in medicine and pharmacology. Traditional anticancer drug discovery relies on in vivo experiments and in vitro drug screening, methods that are important in the discovery of new drugs, yet require more time and resources. Although there are some traditional methods based on machine learning to predict drug-cancer cell lineage response (CDR), these methods are usually based on a single source of information, limiting the interpretation of the panoramic view of cancer cells. Using multi-omics information to comprehensively respond to cancer cells and anticancer drug responses remains a great challenge. In this experiment, we propose MAF-CDR, a CDR prediction model based on the alignment and fusion of multi-omics information. The model fuses multi-omics information in a unified framework and achieves cross-modal information representation through adversarial training to achieve aligned fusion of different modalities. Meanwhile, in order to better capture the correlation between drugs and cancer cell lines, MAF-CDR constructed a graph neural network encoder based on contrast learning to achieve accurate CDR prediction. The experimental results showed that the AUC value of MAF-CDR was higher than 0.8, which was better than other current baseline methods. This indicates that the MAF-CDR method can efficiently promote the development and innovation in the field of drug discovery, and proves the great potential value of deep learning methods in guiding the rapid discovery and precise application of anti-cancer drugs.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Reconstruction Algorithm with Reverse-Projection Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: This paper proposes a Reverse-Projection Constraint Bundle Adjustment (BA) algorithm suitable for Structure from Motion (SFM). The basic idea of this algorithm is to add Reverse-Projection error constraints to the cost function based on the classic BA algorithm. The introduction of these constraints not only improves the accuracy of optimization but also provides the possibility for dynamic adjustment of the optimization scale. Compared with the classic global BA, this algorithm significantly reduces computational complexity and provides more accurate camera pose estimation. We evaluate the speed of algorithm optimization and the accuracy of camera pose and three-dimensional point coordinate estimation on simulated datasets and TAT datasets, confirming that the optimization algorithm proposed in this paper can achieve higher accuracy and reduce the scale of optimization.

articleTitle: The Application of Cluster Analysis Algorithm in Artificial Intelligence+the Improvement of Learning Performance: From the perspective of students scores analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Analysis algorithm plays an important role in artificial intelligence. There are different analysis algorithms. Among them, one of the most classical algorithms is k-means cluster analysis algorithm. On the basis of demand status of students' grades analysis in personal learning system, the research aims to solve the defects because of the unsuitable choose of initial point. At the same while, the data of students' grades analysis has the problems of large quantity and complex data types in personal learning system. The paper links the problems with the innovative application of k-means cluster analysis algorithm. The research uses multiple sampling and one-time clustering to find the optimal improvement algorithm. Through analog system experiment, it proves the application effect and stability of k-means cluster analysis algorithm.

articleTitle: Porting and Optimization of Electric Power Consumers Anomaly Behaviour Monitoring on ARM Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: With the development of smart grid, finer grid monitoring becomes possible. We propose a framework for abnormal behavior monitoring of power users, and carry out targeted deployment and optimization on the ARM platform. In order to align the anomaly detection performance of the model with that of humans, we designed a human-in-the-loop pipeline to achieve more accurate anomaly detection results with a small number of expert annotations. We validate the effectiveness of the proposed method on the electricity data of a region in China.

articleTitle: MSFF-Net: A Multi-Scale Feature Fusion Network for Hippocampus Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: The hippocampus plays an important role in many brain disorders, such as Alzheimer's disease. Accurate measurement of the hippocampus helps clinical doctors detect lesions and diagnose and treat related brain disorders. Therefore, accurate segmentation of the hippocampus is of great significance for in-depth study of many brain disorders. However, segmentation has been a challenging problem due to the small size, irregular shape, and fuzzy boundaries of the hippocampus with surrounding tissues. This paper focuses on the image features of the hippocampus and proposes a multi-scale feature fusion network to tackle the segmentation challenge of the hippocampus. The network adopts an encoder-decoder structure and replaces conventional convolution operations with residual modules to alleviate the problem of gradient vanishing. In the encoding stage, an adaptive SE Block is used to extract feature information of the image. Additionally, an ASPP module is added at the bottleneck layer to capture feature maps at different scales with various dilation rates, thereby improving the segmentation performance for hippocampi of different shapes and sizes. We also designed a Hybrid Attention Fusion module to selectively aggregate feature information from the encoding and decoding stages. This module generates attention maps using channel attention and spatial attention, allowing us to remove redundant information in the skip connections. Finally, the spatial information is restored through the decoder to generate the final prediction. We conducted extensive quantitative comparisons on a publicly available brain MRI dataset, MICCAI 2012, to evaluate the effectiveness of our algorithm. The experimental results show that our model (MSFF-Net) achieves a Dice coefficient of 92.17%, which is 5.88% higher than the traditional UNet model. These results demonstrate that our proposed model has high potential for hippocampus segmentation.

articleTitle: Robust Visual SLAM in Dynamic Environments Using Feature Matching and Regularization
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: In this paper, we consider dynamic visual SLAM based on the feature matching and regularization. Currently, most of the visual SLAM approach is based on the assumption of a static world. In an ideal environment, these methods can achieve good work results, but when dynamic objects appear in the camera field of view, system performance is degraded or even work fails. On the basis of ORB-SLAM2 [2], we design a static map point detection strategy to ensure that only static points are used for pose estimation. Subsequently, in order to further improve the adequacy and accuracy of static map point recognition, we adopted a map point regularization strategy to optimize the dynamic and static labels. Finally, experimental results on the TUM dataset show that our method achieves high accuracy while ensuring real-time performance under a CPU computer.

articleTitle: Eye Movements of Pilot Flying in Simulated Flight: an Eye-Tracking Study
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Flying is a complex and challenging human-machine interaction activity that requires a high level of technical proficiency from pilots. Currently, there is a growing interest of research and increased number of publications in this field, with eye-tracking technology being a commonly used tool. By understanding pilots' overall visual behavior during the flight operations, it is possible to consider improvements in cockpit design to reduce pilots' cognitive load and enhance flight safety and efficiency, thereby ensuring the overall safety of flights. However, current research has some limitations, including incomplete coverage of flight phases and areas of interest (AOIs), as well as inappropriate selection of eye metrics. In this study, the focus is placed on the PF (Pilot Flying) role. The principal objective of this research was to explore pilots' visual attention allocation during a comprehensive range of flight phases, covering as many cockpit AOIs as possible. It is part of a comprehensive research plan, and the first phase results of which are presented in this paper. The findings from this research can be considered for improving pilots' flight training, enhancing the design of human-computer interfaces in the cockpit, and providing insights for the redesign of aircraft cockpits for future single-pilot operations.

articleTitle: Clustering Driven Multi-Hop Graph Attention Network for Speaker Diarization
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Recently, the segmented utterance-level modeling approach based on Graph Attention Network (GAT) has been proved to be effective in Clustering-based Speaker Diarization (CSD). However, these existing methods only rely on the message passing by a single neighbor per layer, ignoring the influence of sub-region and global information. In this paper, we propose clustering driven multi-hop Graph Attention Network (CD-MGAT) with the multi-hop neighbor module and the clustering-oriented prototype module, which effectively explores the sub-region and global information for each segmented utterance. Specifically, the developed modules can adaptively interact with each other by clustering-consistency loss, which ensures the consistency of learning between the prototype and speaker embedding. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our solution on the AMI datasets.

articleTitle: Pig Face Recognition Based on Multi Supervising Forms
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: With the development of intelligent breeding, non-contact pig face recognition based on deep learning has been widely studied, enabling accurate and intensive management. Existing face recognition network training in limited categories cannot meet the requirements for breeding short-growth period edible livestock. Moreover, using a single supervising function is hard to distinguish pig faces that are more similar to humans. Therefore, this paper improves Inner origin loss, which can adaptively adjust repulsive circles, allowing for fast and efficient pig face feature extraction. In addition, we propose the TACO loss which can learn facial features to separate pig faces. The experiments conducted on our dataset indicate that in the 1200 pairs of pig face verification pairs composed of 15 pigs, the accuracy of open-set is 96.08%. This study provides a technical reference for pig face recognition research.

articleTitle: Improved Algorithm for Small Target Detection of Traffic Signs on YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Aiming to address the issues of small target size, complex background, and low recognition accuracy of traffic signs in road scenes, an improved YOLOv5s algorithm is proposed. The algorithm introduces a Coordinate Attention in the feature fusion network, enhancing the model's ability to integrate spatial coordinate information and preserve a wider range of positional information. The Efficient Decoupled Heads are used to replace the Detection Heads in YOLOv5s, with an additional layer for small object detection, improving the model's generalization ability, robustness, and utilization of small object information. The Normalized Wasserstein Distance (NWD) is introduced to mitigate the sensitivity of IoU to small target position deviations. The algorithm is trained on the TT100K dataset with data augmentation and enhancement. Experimental results demonstrate that the improved algorithm achieves a 4.4% increase in mAP@0.5 compared to the original algorithm.

articleTitle: BLH-Slice Modeling Used in Human-Computer Interaction of Ellipsoidal Volume Clipping
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Volume clipping is a human-computer interaction in volume rendering, which is mainly used to display the interested parts in the volume data and hide other ones. However, in the ellipsoidal ray casting algorithm (ERCA) for digital earth, there is still a gap in constructing the selection object in volume clipping conforming to the geodetic or ellipsoidal coordinate system. This paper provides an ellipsoidal BLH-slice volume clipping algorithm (EBLHVC), which gives the simplest mathematical representation of three typical selection object surfaces in the geodetic or ellipsoidal coordinate system, and presents a direct ray sampling method based on the intersection calculation using algebraic equation to realize volume rendering of the selection object surface. The article provides a concise slice display for volume rendering on digital earth.

articleTitle: Folded Handwritten Digit Recognition Based on WGAN-GP Model
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: The study of overlapped handwritten digit recognition algorithms is critical for improving automated recognition accuracy, improving document processing, and automating recognition systems. The majority of current research in this field is focused on detecting two overlapped handwritten numbers. However, when one handwritten digit is folded onto another, recognition becomes more difficult, and there is currently no well-established recognition algorithm for this circumstance. To solve the issue of folded digit recognition, a method is provided that reconstructs the folded handwritten digit images using Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and transformation optimization algorithm, followed by recognition using a recognition network. The MNIST dataset is used to validate the suggested approach. The experimental findings demonstrate that the recognition accuracy reaches 97.22%, proving the suggested approach's considerable promise in solving the recognition of folded handwritten digit images.

articleTitle: Research on Product Image Correlation Based on Electrodermal Signal and Electrocardiogram Signal
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Emotional design of products based on physiological signals has become an entry point for product innovation and design because of its ability to capture implicit needs more objectively and clarify internal emotional change mechanisms., but the degree of association between physiological signal processing techniques and product imagery value mapping has not been widely studied. Based on this., this paper verifies the effectiveness of different pre-processing methods and feature extraction dimensions in relation to products by using electrodermal (EDA) and electrocardiographic (ECG) signals., and the experimental results show that ECG is more sensitive to pre-processing methods than EDA., and the non-linear features of ECG are more relevant to the emotional imagery of products. This leads to the conclusion that different processing techniques should be chosen for different products and target groups.

articleTitle: The Technology of Kiwifruit Pest and Disease Identification Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: [Purpose] To achieve fast and accurate identification of kiwifruit pests and diseases in real environments, a kiwifruit pest and disease identification method based on improved YOLOv7 is proposed.[Methods] Using the YOLOv7 network model as the base network, the feature extraction and feature fusion capabilities of the network model are improved by introducing the proposed multi-scale feature fusion module to improve the recognition accuracy of various types of kiwifruit pests in a balanced manner; The kiwifruit planting bases in South China were used as sample collection points to construct a kiwifruit pest and disease dataset; then, the collected dataset was enhanced by introducing data enhancement methods such as Random Noise, Mixup, and Cutout according to the characteristics of its sample distribution, which enabled the deep learning model to learn the visual features of pest discriminatory power from a deeper dimension; The YOLOv7 network is improved and a multi-scale neural network model based on feature pyramid is constructed to enhance the recognition accuracy of pest and disease features.[Results] Based on the improved YOLOv7 for kiwifruit pests and diseases, the average accuracy reached 94.43%, which is an increase of 6.51 percentage points in accuracy and 6.73 percentage points in mean average accuracy compared to the base network YOLOv5s.[Conclusion] The method can quickly and accurately identify kiwifruit pest and disease targets in real environments. So it can provide a reference for the intelligent management of kiwifruit plantation industry.

articleTitle: Insulator Detection Based on Improved Lightweight Rotation Detector
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Insulator overheating defect detection is an important task in power inspection. The traditional horizontal detector is not precise enough for positioning inclined insulators. Although the general rotation detector can produce a more accurate rotation detection box, it is not suitable for edge device with limited computing power due to its large amount of model parameters. In this paper, we propose a lightweight Rotated RetinaNet (LR-RetinaNet) to address these issues. Firstly, we propose Brief PAFPN to achieve more efficient feature fusion and effectively reduce model parameters. Secondly, we design a lighter Brief Rotated Head to address the increased model computational complexity caused by the heavy head of RetinaNet. Finally, we conducted a series of experiments, which showed that our proposed LR-RetinaNet can effectively reduce model parameters while ensuring detection accuracy, making it more suitable for edge device.

articleTitle: Knowledge Graph Convolutional Recommender Model with Collaborative Information and Common Neighbor Ranking Sampling
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Knowledge graph can be used as auxiliary information in recommendation models. However, some models do not consider collaborative information when extracting structured information, which leads to problems in obtaining high-order representations of items. In addition, some models use fixed sampling sizes to reduce computational costs, but this sampling method cannot distinguish the importance of neighboring entities by randomly selecting samples for selective aggregation of neighborhood information. To address these issues, this paper proposes a knowledge graph convolutional recommendation model that integrates collaborative information and common neighbor ranking sampling. Experimental results show that compared with other baseline models, this model has improved performance in AUC indicators.

articleTitle: Construction of Topological Navigation Map Based on Model Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: With the advancements in artificial intelligence technology and the field of mobile robotics, small robots like drones and unmanned cars have become increasingly visible. However, the trajectory maps created by unmanned vehicles in complex environments pose challenges for planning and navigation tasks, often leading to significant misidentification issues during the mapping process. To tackle these problems, we propose a method for constructing topological navigation maps based on model fusion. This approach aims to reduce the misidentification rate through model fusion, thereby enhancing the efficiency of constructing topological maps. In this study, we utilized the ORB-SLAM2 framework to extract keyframe information from a dataset of unmanned driving videos. These keyframes were fed into a deep learning neural network for intersection recognition. To improve recognition accuracy, we employed model fusion by averaging multiple points on the SGD trajectory using SWA. As a result, we were able to generate a topological map. Our experiments confirmed the effectiveness of the model fusion-based intersection recognition network and the construction of the topological navigation map. Furthermore, we evaluated the fusion method on common benchmark datasets and found that our results were competitive compared to the current state-of-the-art approaches.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Jointless Track Circuit Based on Adaptive Noise Completely Integrated Empirical Modal Decomposition and Deep Belief Network
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: Jointless track circuit signals are often in a multi-vibration, multi-noise operating environment, and the vibration signals show prominent nonlinear characteristics, which leads to the difficulty of extracting the actual fault conditions of JTC. This paper proposes an adaptive noise completely integrated empirical modal decomposition and deep belief network for fault diagnosis. Taking advantage of CEEMDAN's decomposition of nonlinear signals, the filtered effective fault signals of JTC are obtained, the redundant components brought by noise are eliminated, and finally, the effective fault signals obtained by the decomposition of CEEMDAN algorithm are imported into DBN to realize fault diagnosis. The simulation results show that CEEMDAN-DBN can effectively perform JTC fault diagnosis and a new method for JTC fault diagnosis is proposed.

articleTitle: Total Organic Carbon Detection in Water Based on Attention Mechanism CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Human-Computer Interaction (ICHCI)
abstract: With the increasing demand for dynamic control of sewage quality, developing a fast and accurate detection method that can continuously monitor total organic carbon (TOC) in water has become a crucial issue.
